l-m-m1-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: Prime numbers niile bụ odd. Chọta prime number na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: 3 bụ odd prime, ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: 5 bụ odd prime, ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: 11 bụ odd prime, ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s1.explain: 2 bụ prime nwere divisors 1 na 2 naanị, ọ bụkwa even. Ya mere nkwupụta niile bụ odd ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: 2 bụ prime ma even; ya mere nkwupụta primes niile odd dara.
l-m-m1-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Prime number bụ nke divisors ya bụ naanị 1 na ya onwe ya; 2 dị otú ahụ ma even, ya bụ counterexample.

l-m-m1-b01-02.title: Ịgbakwunye nọmba abụọ ọ̀ na-eme ka ọ dị ukwuu mgbe niile?
l-m-m1-b01-02.goal: Nyochaa ma ngụkọta integers abụọ na-adị ukwuu karịa nke ọ bụla mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m1-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ngụkọta integers abụọ na-adị ukwuu karịa number nke ọ bụla agbakwunyere. Chọta addition na-egosi na ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: 7 karịrị 3 na 4 abụọ; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s1.r.b: 7 karịrị 6 na 1 abụọ; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s1.r.c: 10 karịrị 2 na 8 abụọ; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta +3 dị ala karịa 5. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbakwunye number negative, ngụkọta nwere ike ịdị ala karịa nke e tinyere na ya.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: (−2)+(+5)=+3, ma 3 dị ala karịa 5; ngụkọta anaghị abawanye mgbe niile.
l-m-m1-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye number negative na-eweda uru; ngụkọta ghọrọ 3, dị ala karịa 5, ya mere nkwupụta dara.

l-m-m1-b01-03.goal: Nyochaa ma numbers abụọ nwere absolute value otu hà nhata bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m1-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: Numbers abụọ nwere otu absolute value bụ otu number. Chọta ha abụọ na-egosi na ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s1.r.a: Numbers abụọ ahụ bụ otu, absolute value kwa bụ otu; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s1.r.b: Numbers abụọ ahụ bụ otu, absolute value kwa bụ otu; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s1.r.d: Numbers abụọ ahụ bụ otu, absolute value kwa bụ otu; dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s1.explain: −3 na +3 abụọ nwere absolute value 3, ma numbers dị iche.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s2.model.0: −3 na +3 abụọ nwere absolute value 3 ma dị iche; ya bụ counterexample.
l-m-m1-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma anya ha si na 0 bụ otu, numbers nwere ike ịdị n’akụkụ ndị megidere; −3 na +3 na-emebi nkwupụta.

l-m-m1-b01-04.title: 2x ọ̀ na-adị ukwuu karịa x mgbe niile?
l-m-m1-b01-04.goal: Nyochaa ma 2x na-adị ukwuu karịa x mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m1-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: 2x na-adị ukwuu karịa x mgbe niile. Tinye numbers maka x chọta uru na-egosi na ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s1.prompt: Uru x na-eme ka nkwupụta daa bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s1.r.b: 2x=1 karịrị x=1/2; ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: 2x=14 karịrị x=7; ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: 2x=4 karịrị x=2; ya mere dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x=−3, 2x=−6, nke dị ala karịa −3. Nkwupụta dara maka numbers negative; uru ahụ bụ −6 ọzọ.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x=−3, 2x=−6, ma −6 dị ala karịa −3; ya mere 2x anaghị adị ukwuu mgbe niile.
l-m-m1-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe x negative, ịmụba na 2 na-eme ka ọ dị obere; x=−3 bụ counterexample.

l-m-m1-b01-05.title: Ọ bụrụ angles hà nhata, triangles hà congruent?
l-m-m1-b01-05.goal: Nyochaa ma triangles nwere corresponding angles hà nhata na-abụ congruent mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m1-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Triangles abụọ nwere angles atọ nha otu na-abụ congruent. Chọta triangles abụọ na-egosi na ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.r.a: Triangles abụọ ahụ kpuchiri onwe ha kpọmkwem; ha congruent, dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.o.b: Equilateral triangle side 3 na equilateral triangle side 6
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.r.c: Sides atọ ha bụ otu; congruent, dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.o.d: Triangles abụọ nwere angles 30°,60°,90° na hypotenuse 10
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.r.d: Angles na otu side hà nhata; congruent, dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s1.explain: Equilateral triangles sides 3 na 6 nwere angles atọ niile 60°, ma nha ha dị iche; ha abụghị congruent.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: Triangles equilateral abụọ nwere angles 60° niile, ma sides ha dị iche, 3 na 6; ya mere ha abụghị congruent.
l-m-m1-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma angles ha bụ otu, nha nwere ike ịdị iche; triangles equilateral abụọ a bụ counterexample.

l-m-m1-b02-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na quotient nkewa integer abụọ na-abụ integer mgbe niile bụ eziokwu, chọta ọnọdụ ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ na-emegide ya), kọwaa ya.
l-m-m1-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Quotient integer kewara na integer ọzọ na-abụghị 0 na-abụ integer mgbe niile. Chọta nkewa na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Quotient 0 bụ integer, ya mere ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Quotient 4 bụ integer, ya mere ọ dabara.

l-m-m1-b03-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na a²<b² mgbe a<b ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-m-m1-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: ọ bụrụ na a dị obere karịa b, mgbe ahụ a² na-adị obere karịa b² mgbe niile. Tinye ọnụọgụ maka a na b chọta ihe atụ na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m1-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: 1<16, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’ nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-m1-b03-01.s.s1.r.d: 0<9, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’ nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b03-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=−3 na b=2, mgbe ahụ a<b mana a²=9 karịrị b²=4. Ịkpọ nọmba na-adịghị mma square na-eme ka ọ dị mma.
l-m-m1-b03-01.s.s2.model.0: −3<2 mana (−3)²=9 karịrị 2²=4; ya mere ọbụna ma a<b, a²<b² nwere ike ghara ịdị eziokwu.
l-m-m1-b03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ịkpọ nọmba na-adịghị mma square na-eme ka ọ dị mma ma buru ibu; ya mere a=−3 na b=2 bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta.

l-m-m1-b03-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “divisor ọ bụla nke ọnụọgụ eke pere mpe karịa ọnụọgụ ahụ” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m1-b03-03.material: Nkwupụta: divisor ọ bụla nke ọnụọgụ eke pere mpe karịa ọnụọgụ ahụ. N’etiti ndị na-ekewa 12, chọta nke na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m1-b03-03.s.s1.r.a: 2 pere mpe karịa 12, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’ nkwupụta.

l-m-m1-b03-03.s.s1.r.d: 6 pere mpe karịa 12, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’ nkwupụta.
l-m-m1-b03-03.s.s1.explain: 12 na-ekewa site na 12, ya mere 12 bụkwa divisor nke 12. N’ezie, divisor nwere ike ịbụ 12 n’onwe ya.
l-m-m1-b03-03.s.s2.model.0: 12÷12=1, ya mere 12 bụkwa divisor nke 12, mana ọ dịghị obere karịa 12; nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m1-b03-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ ahụ n’onwe ya bụkwa divisor; ya mere divisor 12 nke 12 bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta.

l-m-m1-b03-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “otu nwere relative frequency ka ukwuu nwekwara frequency ka ukwuu” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m1-b03-05.material: Nkwupụta: n’ime otu abụọ, nke nwere relative frequency ka ukwuu na-enwe frequency ka ukwuu mgbe niile. N’iji nhọrọ ndị e nyere frequency na mkpokọta, chọta ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-m1-b03-05.s.s1.r.a: Nke nwere relative frequency ka ukwuu nwekwara frequency ka ukwuu, ya mere nke a kwekọrọ n’ nkwupụta.

l-m-m1-b03-05.s.s1.explain: 10/20=0.5 nwere relative frequency ka 12/60=0.2 ukwuu, mana frequency ya 10 dị obere karịa 12.
l-m-m1-b03-05.s.s2.model.0: 10/20=0.5 karịrị 12/60=0.2, mana frequency 10 pere mpe karịa 12; ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-m-m1-b04-25.title: Ịgbakwunye akụkụ acute abụọ na-abụ mgbe niile akụkụ obtuse?
l-m-m1-b04-25.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ngụkọta akụkụ acute abụọ na-abụ mgbe niile akụkụ obtuse ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ nke ọ bụghị (counterexample).
l-m-m1-b04-25.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na i gbakwunye akụkụ acute abụọ, ngụkọta ahụ na-abụ mgbe niile akụkụ obtuse. (Akụkụ acute karịrị 0° ma erughị 90°.) Chọta mgbakwunye nke na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.r.a: 125° bụ akụkụ obtuse. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.r.b: 110° bụ akụkụ obtuse. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.r.c: 150° bụ akụkụ obtuse. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.explain: 20°+30°=50° bụ akụkụ acute. Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ọnọdụ ngụkọta ahụ na-abụghị obtuse, nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s2.model.0: 20°+30°=50°, 50° abụghị obtuse, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ acute abụọ ahụ dị obere, ngụkọta ha nwekwara ike ịdị ala karịa 90°, ya mere 20° na 30° bụ counterexample.

l-m-m1-b0s4-02.title: Ọ bụrụ na ngụkọta coordinates bụ positive, isi ahụ ọ dị na quadrant nke 1?
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na isi ọ bụla ngụkọta ya positive dị na quadrant nke 1 bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ naghị eme (counterexample).
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.material: Nkwupụta: Maka isi (a, b), ọ bụrụ na a+b bụ positive, isi ahụ na-adị mgbe niile na quadrant nke 1. Chọta isi na-egosi na nkwupụta ezighị ezi. (Quadrant nke 1 bụ ebe x-coordinate na y-coordinate abụọ bụ positive.)
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.a: a+b=7, ọ dịkwa na quadrant nke 1. Nke a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.b: a+b=−3 bụ negative, ya mere ọ naghị emezu ọnọdụ nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.d: a+b=2, ọ dịkwa na quadrant nke 1. Nke a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.explain: Maka (3, −1), a+b=2 bụ positive, ma y-coordinate bụ negative, ya mere ọ dị na quadrant nke 4. Ọbụna ma ngụkọta bụ positive, ọ nwere ike ghara ịdị na quadrant nke 1.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s2.model.0: Maka (3, −1), 3+(−1)=2 bụ positive, ma y-coordinate bụ negative, ya mere ọ dị na quadrant nke 4. Nke a bụ ihe mere ọ ji bụrụ counterexample.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma ngụkọta bụ positive, otu coordinate nwere ike ịbụ negative, ya mere (3, −1) dị na quadrant nke 4, nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-m-m1-b01-06.goal: Kpebie ozi dị mkpa n’ezie iji mata ma number bụ prime; kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b01-06.material: Anyị chọrọ ịmata ma natural number 51 bụ prime. Tụlee ozi dị mkpa iji kpebie ya.
l-m-m1-b01-06.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị dị mkpa n’ezie ikpebi ma number bụ prime?

l-m-m1-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: Ogo naanị anaghị ekpebi ma ọ bụ prime.
l-m-m1-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: E nwere numbers dịka 9 na 15 bụ odd ma ha abụghị prime.
l-m-m1-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: Even ma ọ bụ odd digit sum enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịbụ prime.
l-m-m1-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Prime number nwere naanị divisors 1 na ya onwe ya. 51 divisible kwa na 3, ya mere ọ bụghị prime.

l-m-m1-b01-07.material: Anyị chọrọ ịhazi 6/3, 3/4, 7/2 ka ha bụrụ “integer” na “nọmba rational na-abụghị integer.” Chee echiche banyere ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa.

l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.o.a: Gbakọọ ya, hụkwa ma uru ya ọ bụ integer
l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.r.b: 7/2 abụghị integer n'agbanyeghị na numerator ya karịrị.
l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Were ya dịka na-abụghị integer ma ọ bụrụ na o yie obere akụkụ
l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma o yie obere akụkụ, ọ nwere ike ịbụ integer dịka 6/3=2.
l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Ị gaghị ama ma ọ bụ integer site n'ịma ma denominator bụ even ka ọ bụ odd.
l-m-m1-b01-07.s.s1.explain: 6/3=2 bụ integer, 3/4 na 7/2 bụ rational ndị na-abụghị integer. Ị nwere ike ịmata naanị site n'ịgbakọ uru ya.

l-m-m1-b01-08.title: Ozi achọrọ iji tụnyere olu cylinder
l-m-m1-b01-08.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji tụnyere olu akpa abụọ yiri cylinder, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b01-08.material: Anyị chọrọ iji tụnyere olu akpa abụọ cylinder nwere nha dị iche. Chee echiche banyere ozi dị mkpa n'ezie.
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji tụnyere olu bụ nke?
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.o.a: Radius ntọala na ịdị elu nke akpa ọ bụla
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.o.b: Naanị ịdị elu akpa ọ bụla
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ịmaghị nha ntọala, ị gaghị achọta olu.
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.o.c: Naanị ogologo gburugburu ntọala nke akpa ọ bụla
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ịmaghị ịdị elu, ị gaghị achọta olu.
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Olu cylinder bụ mpaghara ntọala ugboro ịdị elu. Ya mere ị kwesịrị ịma radius na ịdị elu.
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: A na-ekpebi olu site na mpaghara ntọala na ịdị elu; ya mere radius na ịdị elu dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m1-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ naanị ịdị elu ma ọ bụ naanị ogologo gburugburu ntọala, nke ọzọ amaghị, ya mere enweghị ike iji olu tụnyere.

l-m-m1-b01-09.title: Gịnị ka anyị chọrọ iji chọta ugboro ikwu?
l-m-m1-b01-09.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta ugboro ikwu nke klaasị, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b01-09.material: Anyị chọrọ ịchọta ugboro ikwu nke otu klaasị n'ime tebụl nkesa ugboro. Chee echiche banyere ozi dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta ugboro ikwu bụ nke?
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.o.a: Ugboro kacha ukwuu na nke kacha nta
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.r.a: Oke na opekempe naanị ha anaghị agwa gị òkè klaasị ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.o.b: Obosara klaasị na ọnụ ọgụgụ klaasị
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: Obosara klaasị anaghị agwa gị òkè mkpokọta.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Akara klaasị bụ naanị uru etiti klaasị ahụ, enweghịkwa ihe jikọrọ ya na òkè.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.o.d: Ugboro klaasị ahụ na ngụkọta ugboro niile
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ugboro ikwu bụ ugboro klaasị ahụ e kewara na ngụkọta ugboro niile.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: Ugboro ikwu bụ ugboro e kewara na ngụkọta; ya mere ugboro na ngụkọta dị mkpa.
l-m-m1-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: Akara klaasị na obosara anaghị agwa gị òkè mkpokọta, ya mere ha adịghị mkpa.

l-m-m1-b01-10.title: Ụkpụrụ e ji amata ngosipụta linear
l-m-m1-b01-10.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji mata ma ngosipụta bụ linear, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b01-10.material: Anyị chọrọ ịhọrọ “ngosipụta linear” n'ime 3x+2, x²+1, 5, na 4−x. Chee echiche banyere ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji mata ma ngosipụta bụ linear bụ nke?
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: x²+1 nwekwara variable, mana ọ bụghị ngosipụta linear.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.r.b: 4−x nke na-enweghị akara + bụkwa ngosipụta linear.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ numerals enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ogo ngosipụta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ugboro a mụbara variable (ogo) bụ 1
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.explain: Ngosipụta linear bụ nke ogo variable bụ 1. 3x+2 na 4−x bụ linear, x²+1 nwere ogo 2.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Linear chọrọ ka ogo variable bụrụ 1; ya mere ilele ogo bụ ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma variable dị, ọ bụrụ ogo ya bụ 2 dịka x², ọ bụghị linear; ya mere ị ga-enyocha ogo.

l-m-m1-b02-06.goal: Iji mata ma ihe siri ike bụ prism ka ọ bụ pyramid, kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b02-06.material: E nwere ihe siri ike nwere aha yiri ibe ha, dịka prism triangular na pyramid triangular. Ị chọrọ ịmata prism na pyramid iche. Chee echiche banyere ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.prompt: Ụkpụrụ dabara adaba iji mata ọdịiche ha bụ nke?
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ akụkụ na-adị iche ma maka prism ma pyramid.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ vertex na-adị iche ma maka prism ma pyramid.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.o.c: Ma ịdị elu dị ogologo karịa akụkụ ntọala
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo ịdị elu enweghị ike ikewa ụdị ha.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s1.explain: Prism nwere ntọala 2, elu na ala; pyramid nwere ntọala 1. Ọnụọgụ ntọala bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: Prism nwere ntọala 2, pyramid nwere 1; ị nwere ike mata ha site n'ịgụ ntọala.
l-m-m1-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ vertex dị iche n'ụdị nke ọ bụla, ya mere enweghị ike iji ha kewaa ha.

l-m-m1-b02-07.goal: Iji mata quadrant eserese y=ax na-agafe, kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa, kọwaakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b02-07.material: Ị chọrọ ịmata quadrant eserese proportionality y=ax na-agafe. Chee echiche banyere ozi dị mkpa.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma a dị mma ka ọ bụ na-adịghị mma
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.o.b: Ma uru zuru oke nke a buru ibu
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.r.b: Nha ahụ na-ekpebi naanị ka ọ si dị nkọ, ọ naghị ekpebi quadrant ọ na-agafe.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.r.c: Otu uru x naanị enweghị ike ịgwa akara a.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.r.d: Eserese y=ax na-agafe mmalite mgbe niile.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ a>0 ọ na-agafe quadrant 1 na 3; ọ bụrụ a<0 ọ na-agafe 2 na 4. Akara bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ a dị mma, ọ na-agafe quadrant 1 na 3; ma ọ bụrụ na-adịghị mma, 2 na 4, ya mere akara dị mkpa.
l-m-m1-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-agafe mmalite mgbe niile, uru zuru oke na-ekpebi naanị nha mkpọda; ya mere lelee akara.

l-m-m1-b02-08.title: Nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu ka ọ bụ ọtụtụ ọnụ kacha nta?
l-m-m1-b02-08.topic: Nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu na ọtụtụ ọnụ kacha nta
l-m-m1-b02-08.goal: Iji mata nsogbu chọrọ nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu, kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b02-08.material: Ị chọrọ ịkpụ eriri 48 cm na 72 cm ka ha bụrụ iberibe otu ogologo n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ, ka iberibe ahụ dị ogologo dịka o kwere mee. Chee echiche banyere ụkpụrụ ga-ekpebi ma achọrọ nkewa ọnụ kacha ukwuu ka ọ bụ ọtụtụ ọnụ kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: Kedu n'ime ọnụọgụ abụọ ka ukwuu
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: Nha ọnụọgụ naanị anaghị ekpebi ihe a ga-achọta.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: Ma ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ bụ even
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.r.b: Ịbụ even abụghị ụkpụrụ na-ekewa echiche abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ikewa ka ọ bụrụ nha otu
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ha coprime, enwere ike ịchọta uru abụọ ahụ.

l-m-m1-b02-10.title: Ụkpụrụ e ji amata ma ihe bụ nhata
l-m-m1-b02-10.goal: Iji mata ma nhata bụ equation, kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b02-10.material: Ị chọrọ ikewa x+3=3+x, x+3=7, na 2+3=5 ka ha bụrụ “equations” na nhata ndị ọzọ. Chee echiche banyere ụkpụrụ dị mkpa.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.prompt: Ụkpụrụ e ji amata equation bụ nke?
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.r.a: Ụfọdụ nhata nwere akara hà nhata mana ha abụghị equation.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ eziokwu naanị maka ụfọdụ uru x
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma x dị n'akụkụ aka ekpe nke ngosipụta
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọnọdụ x enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịbụ equation.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịbụ equation.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Equation bụ nhata nke eziokwu naanị maka ụfọdụ uru nke unknown. x+3=7 bụ eziokwu naanị mgbe x=4.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: x+3=7 bụ eziokwu naanị mgbe x=4, ya mere ma ọ bụ eziokwu naanị maka uru ụfọdụ bụ ụkpụrụ equation.
l-m-m1-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: Nhata nke bụ eziokwu n'agbanyeghị uru e tinyere maka x, ma ọ bụ nke na-enweghị mkpụrụedemede, abụghị equation; ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa.

l-m-m1-b03-06.s.s1.r.c: N’ọrụ geometric, ị gaghị eji straightedge na-enweghị akara tụọ ogologo.
l-m-m1-b03-06.s.s1.r.d: Iji anya atụnyere ezughị ezi, ya mere ọ bụghị ọrụ geometric.

l-m-m1-b03-08.s.s1.r.a: Ịdị anya site n'etiti etiti abụghị ọkọlọtọ e ji amata chord na arc.

l-m-m1-b03-08.s.s1.r.b: Chord na arc nwere ike ịdị ogologo ma ọ bụ mkpụmkpụ.

l-m-m1-b03-10.goal: Kpebie ọkọlọtọ ozi dị mkpa iji mata ma okwu algebra hà bụ like terms, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b03-10.material: Ị chọrọ ikpokọta like terms n'ime 3x, 5y, −2x, x², na 7. Chee echiche banyere ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa.
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ọkọlọtọ e ji amata like terms?

l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.r.b: 3x na −2x bụ like terms ọ bụrụgodị na coefficient ha dị iche.
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma mgbanwe na ogo ya bụ otu
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma ha nọ nso ibe ha n'ime okwu algebra
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.r.d: Ha nwere ike ịbụ like terms ọbụna ma ha dị anya n'ebe ibe ha nọ.
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s1.explain: 3x na −2x nwere otu mgbanwe x na ogo 1, ya mere ha bụ like terms. x² nwere ogo dị iche, ya mere ọ bụghị like term.
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: 3x na −2x nwere otu mgbanwe na ogo, ya mere ha bụ like terms ọbụna ma coefficient ha dị iche.
l-m-m1-b03-10.s.s2.model.1: x² nwere otu mgbanwe ma ogo dị iche, ya mere ọ bụghị like term nke 3x.

l-m-m1-b04-02.goal: Iji mata ma nọmba ọ bụ ọtụtụ nke 12, chọpụta ozi dị mkpa n’ezie ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b04-02.material: Ị chọrọ iji naanị mmebi praịm mata ma nọmba ọ bụ ọtụtụ nke 12. Kedu ụkpụrụ ị ga-elele?
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s1.r.a: 6=2×3 nwekwara naanị praịm 2 na 3, ma ọ bụghị ọtụtụ nke 12.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s1.o.b: 2 pụtara ugboro 2 ma ọ bụ karịa, 3 pụtara ugboro 1 ma ọ bụ karịa.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: 22 nwere 2 n’ọnọdụ otu ma ọ bụghị ọtụtụ nke 12.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s1.r.d: 18 nwere ndị nkewa 6, ma ọ bụghị ọtụtụ nke 12.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s1.explain: 12=2²×3; nọmba bụ ọtụtụ nke 12 naanị ma mmebi praịm ya nwere 2 abụọ na opekata mpe otu 3.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s2.model.0: 12=2²×3, ya mere a chọrọ opekata mpe 2 abụọ na otu 3.
l-m-m1-b04-02.s.s2.model.1: Nọmba dịka 6 nke nwere praịm 2 na 3 naanị abụghịkwa ọtụtụ nke 12; lelee ugboro ole praịm nke ọ bụla dị.

l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Sum numbers nwere akara dị iche na-ewere akara nke nwere absolute value ka ukwuu. Maka −7 na +4, 7 ka ukwuu, sum negative.

l-m-m1-b05-10.goal: Kọwaa ozi dị mkpa ịchọta mgbe ax=b enweghị solution; kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b05-10.material: Na equation ax=b n’ime x, ịchọrọ ịchọta ọnọdụ enweghị x na-eme ka equation bụrụ eziokwu. Kedu ọnọdụ gbasara a na b ga-enyocha?
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ a=0,b=0, 0·x=0; x niile bụ solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ b=0, x=0 bụ solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna a bụrụ negative, x=b/a bụ solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ a=0, 0·x=b. Ọ bụrụ b≠0, x ọ bụla anaghị arụ; enweghị solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ a=0, akụkụ aka ekpe na-adị 0; enweghị solution naanị mgbe b abụghị 0.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ a=0,b=0, x niile bụ solution; ya mere lelee b≠0 kwa.

l-m-m1-b05-18.goal: Kọwaa criterion (ozi) ị ga-enwerịrị iji chọta ọnọdụ nke ego dị n'akpa ego ezì ji ọnụ ọgụgụ izu echekwa ego bụrụ direct proportion, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b05-18.material: Ị na-etinye otu ego ahụ n'akpa ego ezì kwa izu. Chee echiche banyere ozi dị gị mkpa n'ezie ka mmekọrịta dị n'etiti izu x na ego y bụrụ direct proportion (ahịrị kwụ ọtọ gafere origin).
l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ego na mbido, ego mgbe izu 0 bụchaghị 0, ya mere ọ bụghị direct proportion.

l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s1.r.c: Agba na nha enweghị njikọ na mmekọrịta ego na ọnụ ọgụgụ izu.
l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s1.r.d: Afọ enweghị njikọ na mmekọrịta ego na ọnụ ọgụgụ izu.
l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s1.explain: Ego mmalite ga-abụ 0 won ka y=0 mgbe x=0. Ọ bụrụ na a na-agbakwunye otu ego kwa izu, ọdịdị ya bụ y=ax.
l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ direct proportion naanị mgbe y=0 na x=0, ya mere n'ezie ị kwesịrị ịma ma ego mmalite bụ 0 won.
l-m-m1-b05-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ego na mbido, graph anaghị agafe origin, ya mere ọ bụghị direct proportion.

l-m-m1-b0s4-03.goal: Iji chọta ngụkọta interior angles nke convex polygon, kpebie criterion (ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.material: Ị chọrọ ịchọta ngụkọta interior angles nke convex polygon. Polygon nke ọ bụla nwere ọdịdị na nha dị iche. Chee echiche banyere ozi na-ekpebi ngụkọta ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi dị mkpa n'ezie iji mara ngụkọta interior angles?
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma otu akụkụ dị ogologo, ngụkọta interior angles anaghị agbanwe. Achọghị ogologo akụkụ ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma perimeter hà nhata, ngụkọta dị iche ma ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ akụkụ dị iche.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.c: Otu nnukwu angle naanị enweghị ike ịgwa gị ngụkọta akụkụ ndị ọzọ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta interior angles bụ (ọnụọgụ akụkụ−2)×180°, ya mere a na-ekpebi ya site n'ịmara naanị ọnụọgụ akụkụ. Achọghị ogologo akụkụ ma ọ bụ perimeter.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị mara ọnụọgụ akụkụ, ị nwere ike ikewa polygon ka ọ bụrụ triangles chọta ngụkọta ahụ, ya mere ọnụọgụ akụkụ dị mkpa n'ezie.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ọnụọgụ akụkụ bụ otu, ngụkọta ya bụ otu ọbụna ma ọdịdị dị iche, ya mere ogologo na perimeter adịghị mkpa, ọnụọgụ akụkụ naanị ezuola.

l-m-m1-b0s4-04.title: Criterion ikpebi ma segment parallel na x-axis
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.topic: Isi na line segments na coordinate plane
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.goal: Iji mara ma line segment jikọtara isi abụọ parallel na x-axis, kpebie criterion (ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie, kọwaa ihe kpatara nhọrọ ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.material: Ị chọrọ ịma ma line segment PQ jikọtara isi abụọ P na Q na coordinate plane ọ parallel na x-axis. Chee echiche banyere ihe ị ga-eji tụnyere n'ime coordinates nke isi abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.o.a: Ma x-coordinates nke isi abụọ ahụ hà nhata
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ x-coordinates bụ otu, segment ahụ parallel na y-axis. Ọ dị iche na x-axis.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.o.b: Ma isi abụọ ahụ nọ n’otu quadrant
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.r.b: Isi abụọ n’otu quadrant nwekwara ike ijikọ diagonal.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.o.c: Ma anya site origin ruo isi abụọ ahụ bụ otu
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna anya ha hà nhata, ha nwere ike ghara parallel, dịka (3, 4) na (5, 0).
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.o.d: Ma y-coordinates nke isi abụọ hà nhata
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ y-coordinates hà nhata, isi abụọ ahụ dị n’otu height; segment ahụ kwụ horizontal, parallel na x-axis. Ozi ndị ọzọ anaghị ekpebi parallel.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ y-coordinates hà nhata, isi abụọ ahụ nọ n’otu height site na x-axis; segment ahụ parallel na x-axis.
l-m-m1-b0s4-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ x-coordinates hà nhata, ọ na-abụ vertical line, ọ bụghị parallel na x-axis. Quadrants ma ọ bụ distances anaghị egosi height, ya mere ha adịghị mkpa.

l-m-m1-b02-11.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nha otu akụkụ mpụta polygon mgbe niile, kwuo ya ma nwalee iwu ahụ n'ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m1-b02-11.material: Otu akụkụ mpụta triangle mgbe niile bụ 120°, square bụ 90°, pentagon mgbe niile bụ 72°, hexagon bụ 60°. Chọta iwu etu nha akụkụ mpụta si agbanwe ka ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ na-abawanye.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.prompt: N'iji iwu ahụ, otu akụkụ mpụta octagon mgbe niile bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ mbelata adịghị otu, ya mere ọ naghị ebelata na 12 oge ọ bụla.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ akụkụ mpụta nonagon mgbe niile. E gụrụ ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: E were ya dịka ọkara nke 60°, mana iwu bụ 360°÷ọnụọgụ akụkụ.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Otu akụkụ mpụta×ọnụọgụ akụkụ=360°. Maka octagon mgbe niile, 360÷8=45°.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Otu akụkụ mpụta ugboro ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ na-abụ 360° mgbe niile; ya mere maka octagon 360÷8=45°.
l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: 120×3, 90×4, 72×5, 60×6 niile bụ 360; ya mere maka akụkụ 8 ọ bụ 45°.

l-m-m1-b02-12.material: 3¹=3, 3²=9, 3³=27, 3⁴=81, 3⁵=243, 3⁶=729. Chọta iwu etu ọnụọgụ nkeji si agbanwe.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: N'iji iwu ahụ, ọnụọgụ nkeji nke 3²⁰ bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s1.r.a: 3²⁰ nọ n'ebe okirikiri zuru ezu mechiri, ya mere ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ mbụ 3.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: 7 bụ mgbe fọdụrụ exponent e kewara na 4 bụ 3.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: 9 bụ mgbe fọdụrụ exponent e kewara na 4 bụ 2.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ nkeji na-emegharị 3, 9, 7, 1 kwa oge anọ. 20 bụ ọtụtụ nke 4, ya mere ọ bụ 1.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Ones digit na-emeghachi 3, 9, 7, 1 kwa oge 4. Exponent 20 na-enye digit ikpeazụ 1; sequence 3, 9, 7, 1 na-emegharị.
l-m-m1-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: 20 bụ ọtụtụ nke 4; cycle zuru ezu, ones digit nke 3²⁰ bụ 1.

l-m-m1-b02-13.s.s1.prompt: Perimeter mgbe e jikọtara tiles 10 bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b02-13.s.s1.r.a: E gbakọrọ naanị 2×10. Tinye 2 cm nke nsọtụ abụọ.
l-m-m1-b02-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọ naghị abawanye 4 cm maka tile ọ bụla; a na-ewepụ sides e jikọtara na perimeter.
l-m-m1-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Mgbe agbakwunyere tile 1, perimeter na-arị elu 2 cm. Iwu bụ 2×(ọnụọgụ tiles)+2; ya mere 22 cm.
l-m-m1-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Perimeter na-arị elu 2 cm oge ọ bụla e tinyere tile; tiles 10 bụ 4+2×9=22 cm.

l-m-m1-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: Ịchịkọta abụọ abụọ na-enye −1 kwa ìgwè; numbers 100 bụ ìgwè 50, sum bụ −50.

l-m-m1-b03-11.title: Iwu Maka Ọnụọgụ Ebe Ahịrị Na-ezukọta Ka Ahịrị Na-abawanye
l-m-m1-b03-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ maka ọnụ ọgụgụ kachasị elu ebe ahịrị ole e nyere na-ezukọta, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa iwu ahụ.
l-m-m1-b03-11.material: See ahịrị ka nke ọ bụla ghara ịdị parallel, ahịrị atọkwa ghara izute n'otu isi. Ahịrị 2 nwere ebe nzukọ 1, ahịrị 3 nwere 3, ahịrị 4 nwekwara 6. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.prompt: Dịka iwu ahụ si dị, ebe nzukọ ole ka ahịrị 5 nwere?
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: Ị nọgidere na-abawanye ya site na 2.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.r.b: Ị nọgidere na-abawanye ya site na 3.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: Ị were mmụba ahụ dị ka 6. Ọ na-abawanye site na 4.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ ebe nzukọ 1, 3, 6 na-abawanye site na 2, ma mesịa 3. Nke na-esote na-abawanye site na 4, ya mere 6+4=10.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: Mmụba ahụ na-abawanye otu otu: 2, 3, ya mere nke na-esote bụ 4, ma 6+4=10 ebe nzukọ.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị ọhụrụ na-ezute ahịrị ọ bụla gara aga otu ugboro, ya mere ahịrị nke 5 na-agbakwunye 4, mee 10.

l-m-m1-b03-12.title: Iwu Maka Ọnụọgụ Ndị Na-ekewa Ike nke 2
l-m-m1-b03-12.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke ọnụọgụ ndị na-ekewa ike nke 2, kọwaa usoro ị hụrụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m1-b03-12.material: Ndị na-ekewa 2 bụ 1 na 2, ya mere e nwere 2. Ndị na-ekewa 4 bụ 1, 2, 4, ya mere e nwere 3. Ndị na-ekewa 8 bụ 1, 2, 4, 8, ya mere e nwere 4. Chọta usoro ọnụọgụ ndị na-ekewa ka ike nke 2 na-abawanye.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.prompt: Dịka usoro ahụ si dị, ndị na-ekewa ole ka 2⁷=128 nwere?
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: 1 bụkwa onye na-ekewa. Ị kwesịrị ịgbakwunye 1 na exponent.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ ndị na-ekewa anaghị aghọ okpukpu abụọ nke exponent.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: 64 bụ naanị otu onye na-ekewa 128, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ ndị na-ekewa.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.explain: 2¹ nwere ndị na-ekewa 2, 2² nwere 3, 2³ nwekwara 4, ya bụ 1 karịa exponent. 2⁷ nwere 7+1=8 ndị na-ekewa.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe exponent bụ 1, 2, 3, ọnụọgụ ndị na-ekewa bụ 2, 3, 4, nke bụ 1 karịa exponent, ya mere 2⁷ nwere ndị na-ekewa 8.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Ike nke 2 dịka 1, 2, 4, …, 128 bụ ndị na-ekewa niile, 1 bụkwa onye na-ekewa, ya mere ha dị 8.

l-m-m1-b03-13.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke otu y si agbanwe ka x na-abawanye, kọwaa usoro ị hụrụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m1-b03-13.material: Mgbe x bụ 1, 2, 3, 6, y bụ 12, 6, 4, 2. Chọta usoro dị n'etiti x na y.
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s1.prompt: Dịka usoro ahụ si dị, gịnị bụ y mgbe x=4?
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s1.r.c: x si na 3 bawanye, ma y buru ibu karịa 4.
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: x si na 3 bawanye, ma y buru nnọọ ibu karịa 4.
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s1.explain: x mụbaa y na-adị 12 mgbe niile. Ya mere mgbe x=4, y=12÷4=3.
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Ịmụba x na y na-enye 1×12, 2×6, 3×4, 6×2, ha niile bụ 12, ya mere ọ bụrụ na x=4, y=3.
l-m-m1-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Ngwakọta ahụ na-adị 12, ya mere mgbe x=4, y bụ 12 e kewara site na 4, nke bụ 3.

l-m-m1-b03-14.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke ịgbakwunye fractions n'otu n'otu, kọwaa usoro ị hụrụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m1-b03-14.material: 1/2=1/2, 1/2+1/4=3/4, 1/2+1/4+1/8=7/8. Chọta usoro ngụkọta mgbe ị na-agbakwunye fractions ndị na-adị ọkara nke nke gara aga.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s1.prompt: Dịka usoro ahụ si dị, gịnị bụ 1/2+1/4+1/8+1/16?
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s1.r.b: Ngụkọta ahụ na-abịaru 1 nso ma ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-abụ 1.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s1.r.c: Numerator na-aga 1, 3, 7. Mgbe 7 gachara bụ 15, ọ bụghị 13.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: Ị hụghị usoro na-eme ka numerator bụrụ 1, 3, 7.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta ndị ahụ bụ 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, numerator na-abụkwa 1 erughị denominator. Ọ bụrụ na denominator bụ 16, ọ bụ 15/16.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta bụ 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, numerator na-erughị denominator site na 1, ya mere mgbe denominator bụ 16, ọ bụ 15/16.
l-m-m1-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Fraction ọ bụla agbakwunyere bụ ọkara nke nke bu ya ụzọ, ihe fọdụrụ iru 1 bụ 1/16, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 15/16.

l-m-m1-b03-15.title: Ọnụọgụ Negative na Akara Ngwakọta
l-m-m1-b03-15.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke akara ngwakọta nke ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ, kọwaa usoro ị hụrụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m1-b03-15.material: (−2)×3×4=−24, (−2)×(−3)×4=24, (−2)×(−3)×(−4)=−24. Chọta usoro dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ negative na akara ngwakọta.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s1.prompt: Dịka usoro ahụ si dị, gịnị bụ (−1)×(−2)×(−3)×(−4)×5?
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ọnụọgụ negative dị 4, ọnụọgụ ọbụna, ngwakọta ahụ dị mma.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.c: I wepụrụ 5 a mụbara na njedebe.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.d: I wepụrụ 5 ma gụọkwa akara ahụ n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ negative na-adịghị ọbụna na-enye −, nke ọbụna na-enye +. E nwere negative 4, ya mere ọ bụ +, nha ya bụ 1×2×3×4×5=120.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ negative ọbụna na-eme ka ngwakọta dị mma, ya mere ngwakọta a nwere negative 4 bụ +120.
l-m-m1-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe negative dị 1 ma ọ bụ 3 ngwakọta bụ −, mgbe 2 ọ bụ +, ya mere mgbe 4 ọ bụ +, nha ya bụ 120.

l-m-m1-b04-03.s.s1.r.c: I were n n’onwe ya dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ; iwu ahụ bụ 100÷n.

l-m-m1-b04-11.title: Iwu ịchọta azịza x−a=b
l-m-m1-b04-11.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọmụmaatụ azịza equations x−a=b; kwuo ma nwalee n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m1-b04-11.material: Azịza x−3=5 bụ 8; x−7=2 bụ 9; x−1=6 bụ 7. Chọta mmekọrịta azịza na numbers abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ iwu ahụ na-aga n’ihu, azịza x−12=4 bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: I wepụrụ, dịka 12−4. N’ọmụmaatụ, solution bụ sum nke numbers abụọ.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: I gbakọrọ dịka 4−12. N’ọmụmaatụ, solution bụ sum ha.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: I mụbara numbers abụọ. Solution abụghị product.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Azịza x−a=b bụ a+b. Ịgbakwunye a n’akụkụ abụọ na-ahapụ x; x−12=4 na-enye x=16.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: N’ọnọdụ atọ niile, ịgbakwunye number e wepụrụ na nsonaazụ na-enye azịza; 12+4=16.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: E wepụrụ 12 na x, fọdụrụ 4; ya mere x bụ 4+12=16. Ọmụmaatụ ndị ọzọ na-arụ otu ụzọ.

l-m-m1-b04-27.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ uru maka octagon. Ị kwesịrị ịga n'ihu otu nzọụkwụ.

l-m-m1-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Quadrilateral nwere 2, pentagon 3, hexagon 4, ya bụ 2 erughị ọnụọgụ akụkụ, ya mere nonagon nwere 9−2=7.

l-m-m1-b04-35.s.s2.model.1: A ga-enwe otu ọnụ ọgụgụ values n’akụkụ abụọ; n’ime 13, 6 n’akụkụ nke ọ bụla, nke 7 bụ etiti.

l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na otu iwu ahụ metụta, edges ole ka octagonal prism nwere?
l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ vertices. Ọnụọgụ edges bụ okpukpu 3 nke akụkụ ntọala.
l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ edges nke heptagonal prism. Octagonal prism kwesịrị ịga n'ihu.
l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ edges nke nonagonal prism. Ị gara otu nzọụkwụ karịa.

l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ ahụ na-abawanye site na 3 oge ọ bụla, dịka triangular prism nwere 9 na square prism nwere 12; ọ bụ okpukpu 3 nke akụkụ ntọala, ya mere octagonal prism nwere 24.
l-m-m1-b05-27.s.s2.model.1: Tinye edges 8 na ntọala elu na ala nke ọ bụla na side edges 8, ya mere 8×3=24.

l-m-m1-b0s4-05.material: Na circle radius 6 cm, arc lengths maka central angles 30°,60°,90°,120° bụ π,2π,3π,4π cm. Chọta etu arc length si agbanwe ka angle na-abawanye.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.prompt: Site n’iwu ahụ, arc length mgbe central angle bụ 150° bụ cm ole?

l-m-m1-b03-17.material: Ị chọrọ iji akwụkwọ kechie igbe prism rektangulu dị ogologo 9.8 cm, obosara 5.1 cm, ịdị elu 3.9 cm. Mechie ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ ruo integer kacha nso ma tụọ mpaghara elu.
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ole ka mpaghara elu ya hà?
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: Ị chọtara mpaghara naanị otu nnukwu ihu.
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: Ị gụgharịrị ihu ọ bụla kwekọrọ ugboro abụọ ọzọ, ya mere ọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ.
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Ị chọtara naanị ọkara, n'ebughị ihu ndị na-abụghị ibe ha ugboro abụọ.
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s1.explain: Ịmechi ruo 10, 5, 4 na-enye 2×(10×5+10×4+5×4)=2×110=220. Ọ bụ ihe dịka 220 cm².
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Ịmechi ruo 10, 5, 4 na-enye 2×(50+40+20)=220, ya mere mpaghara elu bụ ihe dịka 220 cm².
l-m-m1-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: E nwere 2 ihu n’ime ụdị ihu ọ bụla na-abụghị ibe ha, ya mere ihe dịka 220 cm², okpukpu abụọ nke ngụkọta ụdị ihu atọ, bụ ihe ezi uche dị na ya.

l-m-m1-b03-18.title: Ịtụ Ogologo E Gara na Ọsọ Kwụsiri Ike
l-m-m1-b03-18.topic: Ịtụ site na Nha Nha Kpọmkwem
l-m-m1-b03-18.goal: Tụọ ogologo e gara na ọsọ kwụsiri ike, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m1-b03-18.material: Ịnyịnya ígwè na-aga mgbe niile 31 km n'ime 1 hour. Tụọ ihe dịka ole ọ ga-aga n'ime 1 hour 58 minutes.

l-m-m1-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: I were oge ahụ dị nso na 4 hours.
l-m-m1-b03-18.s.s1.explain: Ịtụgharị 31 ka 30, awa 1 nkeji 58 ka awa 2 na-enye 30×2=60. Ọ bụ ihe dịka 60 km.
l-m-m1-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Ịtụgharị 31 km ka 30 km, awa 1 nkeji 58 ka awa 2 na-enye 30×2=60; ihe dịka 60 km.
l-m-m1-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Anya na time dị proportional ozugbo; ma time fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ugboro 2, anya bụ ihe dịka 60 km.

l-m-m1-b04-04.goal: Tụọ ọnọdụ −10/3; họrọ oke kwesịrị ekwesị ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m1-b04-04.material: Ị chọrọ igosi −10/3 n’elu number line. Tụọ 10÷3 iji mara integers abụọ ọ dị n’etiti.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.a: I tụrụ 10/3 n’etiti 1 na 2; ọ dị nso 3×3=9.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.b: I chere 10/3 dị n’etiti 2 na 3; ọ karịrị 3.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: I chere 10/3 karịrị 4. 3×4=12; ya mere ọ pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s1.explain: 10/3=3.33…, ya mere −10/3=−3.33…. Ọ dị n’etiti −4 na −3 n’elu number line.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s2.model.0: 10/3 bụ ihe dịka 3.3; ya mere −10/3 bụ −3.3, n’etiti −4 na −3.
l-m-m1-b04-04.s.s2.model.1: 3×3=9 na 3×4=12; ya mere 10/3 dị n’etiti 3 na 4. Negative na-agbanwe akara naanị; ya mere n’etiti −4 na −3.

l-m-m1-b04-28.title: Ịtụ otu interior angle nke polygon regular
l-m-m1-b04-28.topic: Interior na exterior angles nke polygons
l-m-m1-b04-28.goal: Tụọ otu interior angle nke icosagon regular iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m1-b04-28.material: Ka polygon regular nwere akụkụ na-abawanye, ka ọ na-adị ka gburugburu. Tụọ ihe dịka nha otu interior angle nke icosagon regular. (Ngụkọta exterior angles 20 bụ 360°.)
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dịka ogo ole ka otu interior angle bụ?
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nha otu exterior angle. Maka interior angle, wepụ exterior angle na 180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ otu interior angle nke square. Nwere akụkụ 20, ọ ga-ebu nnọọ ibu.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: 360° bụ ngụkọta exterior angles. Otu interior angle erughị 180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.explain: Otu exterior angle bụ 360°÷20=18°, interior angle bụkwa 180°−18°=162°. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dịka 160°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: Exterior angle bụ ihe dịka 360÷20=18°, ya mere interior angle bụ 180−18=162°, ihe dịka 160°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Nwere akụkụ 20 ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ gburugburu, ya mere otu interior angle dị nso na 180°, ya bụ ihe dịka 160°, nke dị 18° ala.

l-m-m1-b05-12.material: Mgbe x=−0.012, agbakọla 100x+2 kpọmkwem. Buru ụzọ tụọ 100x, chọta uru ahụ.
l-m-m1-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: I tụrụ naanị 100x. A ga-agbakwunye +2 kwa.
l-m-m1-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: Ị were 100x dị ka 0. 100x bụ ihe dịka −1.
l-m-m1-b05-12.s.s1.r.d: Ị were 100x dị ka ihe dịka +1. x bụ negative, ya mere 100x bụkwa negative.
l-m-m1-b05-12.s.s1.explain: 100×(−0.012)=−1.2, ya mere 100x bụ ihe dịka −1. Ịgbakwunye 2 na nke ahụ na-enye ihe dịka 1.

l-m-m1-b04-05.goal: Soro ngwọta ịgbakwunye fraction negative na positive; chọta njehie mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m1-b04-05.material: A doziri (−1/2)+(1/3) otu a. ① Chọta common denominator site na LCM nke denominators, 6 ② −1/2=−3/6, 1/3=2/6 ③ −3/6+2/6=−5/6 ④ Azịza bụ −5/6
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: LCM nke denominators 2 na 3 bụ 6; ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Nsonaazụ common denominators abụọ ziri ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: ④ na-edepụta ③ naanị; ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ njehie dị.
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Maka sum numbers nwere akara dị iche, chọta ọdịiche absolute values ma were akara nke nke ka ukwuu. −3/6+2/6=−1/6.
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s2.model.0: Maka numbers akara ha dị iche, chọta ọdịiche 3 na 2; ③ kwesịrị ịbụ −1/6.
l-m-m1-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: −3+2 bụ −1, ọ bụghị −5; ya mere ③ ezighị ezi. Azịza ziri ezi bụ −1/6.

l-m-m1-b04-13.goal: Soro ngwọta linear equation site n’ịbugharị terms; chọta ebe mbụ njehie dị ma dozie ya.
l-m-m1-b04-13.material: Onye dozie 3(x−1)=2x+4 otu a. ① 3(x−1)=2x+4 ② 3x−3=2x+4 ③ 3x−2x=4−3 ④ x=1

l-m-m1-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ ③; ọ bụghị ebe mbụ njehie dị.

l-m-m1-b04-29.title: Kedu ahịrị dị na ngwọta triangle isosceles ezighị ezi?
l-m-m1-b04-29.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta base angles triangle isosceles (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) nzọụkwụ n'ọzọụkwụ, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ.
l-m-m1-b04-29.material: N'ime triangle ABC ebe AB=AC na ∠A=50°, a chọtara ∠B otu a. ① Ebe AB=AC, ∠B=∠C ② Ngụkọta interior angles bụ 180° ③ ∠B+∠C=180°−50°=130° ④ ∠B=130°
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na AB=AC, base angles ∠B na ∠C hà nhata, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ eziokwu na ngụkọta interior angles triangle bụ 180°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.explain: ∠B na ∠C hà nhata, ngụkọta ha bụ 130°, ya mere ∠B=130°÷2=65°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta ∠B na ∠C bụ 130°, ma e kwuru na ∠B naanị bụ 130°, ya mere ④ ezighị ezi. Ikewa na 2 na-enye 65°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: ∠B=∠C, ya mere a ga-ekewa 130° ụzọ abụọ, nke mere ∠B=65° ji bụrụ eziokwu.

l-m-m1-b04-37.title: Nyocha ngwọta gụrụ “70 ma ọ bụ karịa”
l-m-m1-b04-37.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere “70 ma ọ bụ karịa”; chọta ma dozie njehie mbụ.
l-m-m1-b04-37.material: Frequency: 3 na 50~60 points; 8 na 60~70; 6 na 70~80; 5 na 80~90 (at least~less than). Ịchọta ndị 70 ma ọ bụ karịa: classes 60~70, 70~80, 80~90; 70~80 na 80~90 bụ classes 70 na 80. 8+6+5=19; 19 n’ime mmadụ 22. Nsonaazụ bụ 19 ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ soro ①, 8+6+5=19 gbakọtara nke ọma. Njehie bịara tupu ya.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.c: ③ na-ede nsonaazụ ② naanị; ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.d: ④ na-eme ③ ka ahịrịokwu; ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s1.explain: 70 ma ọ bụ karịa bụ classes 70~80 na 80~90; ya bụ 6+5=11 ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s2.model.0: Class 60~70 dị n’okpuru 70, agaghị etinye ya; nsonaazụ 6+5=11.
l-m-m1-b04-37.s.s2.model.1: Ọ ezighị ezi n’ihi na e tinyere 60~70 na ①. Classes abụọ naanị nwere 70 ma ọ bụ karịa.

l-m-m1-b05-21.title: Ịlele ngwọta mpaghara triangle n'ime coordinate plane
l-m-m1-b05-21.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta mpaghara triangle n'ime coordinate plane nzọụkwụ n'ọzọụkwụ (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ), chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ.
l-m-m1-b05-21.material: A chọtara mpaghara triangle ABC nwere vertex A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(4, 3) otu a. ① AB=4 ② BC=3 ③ Mpaghara bụ 4×3=12 ④ Azịza bụ 12
l-m-m1-b05-21.s.s1.r.a: Ọdịiche x-coordinates nke A na B bụ 4, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-m1-b05-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọdịiche y-coordinates nke B na C bụ 3, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.

l-m-m1-b04-22.material: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ọbá akwụkwọ dị square 4 n'aka ekpe na square 3 n'elu site na origin (ụlọ akwụkwọ). Gbanwee ọnọdụ a site n'okwu gaa na ordered pair (x-coordinate, y-coordinate).

l-m-m1-b05-22.title: Ịtụgharị nhatanha inverse proportion ka ọ bụrụ tebụl
l-m-m1-b05-22.goal: Gbanwee tebụl na-egosi y=20/x gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (okwu algebra, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-m1-b05-22.material: Achọrọ m ịtụgharị mmekọrịta y=20/x ka ọ bụrụ tebụl. Dee uru y n'usoro mgbe x bụ 1, 2, 4, na 5.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s1.prompt: Kedu tebụl na-egosi otu mmekọrịta ahụ dị na nhatanha a?
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s1.r.a: Ka x na-abawanye, y na-abawanye kwa. Nke a bụ tebụl direct proportion y=20x.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ tebụl y=20−x. Ngwakọta x×y anaghị adị otu.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ tebụl y=x+20. Ọ bụghị inverse proportion.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s1.explain: Mgbe x bụ 1, 2, 4, 5, y=20÷x bụ 20, 10, 5, 4. Ngwakọta x na y bụ 20 mgbe niile.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s2.model.0: Ịtinye x=1, 2, 4, 5 n'ime y=20÷x na-enye 20, 10, 5, 4, ya mere tebụl ahụ dabara na nhatanha.
l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s2.model.1: Ngwakọta x na y bụ 20 mgbe niile, ya mere mgbe x ghọrọ okpukpu 2, y na-aghọ ọkara.

l-m-m1-b05-30.title: Akụkụ abụọ dị n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ dịka nhatanha
l-m-m1-b05-30.goal: Gbanwee nha akụkụ abụọ dị n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ gaa n'ụdị okwu ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-m1-b05-30.material: Akụkụ abụọ nọ n'akụkụ ibe ha n'otu isi n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ. Otu bụ x°, nke ọzọ bụ (2x+30)°. Tụgharịa ọnọdụ a ka ọ bụrụ nhatanha.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: 360° bụ otu ntụgharị zuru ezu. Ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s1.r.c: Ị were akụkụ abụọ ahụ ka hà nhata. Ị kwesịrị ikwu na ngụkọta ha bụ 180°.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: 90° bụ right angle. Ngụkọta akụkụ n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°. Ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụ 180°, ya mere x+(2x+30)=180, x=50.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°, ya mere ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụ 180°, na-enye x+(2x+30)=180.
l-m-m1-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ abụọ nọ n'akụkụ na-agbakọta ka straight angle, nke bụ 180°, idozi ya na-enye x=50.

l-m-m1-b05-23.material: E nwere isi P(−3, 2) na isi Q(−3, −2). A: Isi abụọ ahụ nwere symmetry gbasara x-axis. B: Isi abụọ ahụ nwere symmetry gbasara y-axis.

l-m-m1-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: P na Q nwere otu x-coordinate, naanị akara y-coordinate dị iche, ya mere ha chere ibe ha n'ofe x-axis. A ziri ezi.

l-m-m1-b05-31.title: Ịrụ equilateral triangle: atụnyere ụzọ abụọ
l-m-m1-b05-31.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara iwu equilateral triangle n'ahịrị AB dịka otu akụkụ, họrọ nke dabara karịa ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m1-b05-31.material: Rụọ equilateral triangle nke line segment AB bụ otu akụkụ. M: See arcs nwere radius AB site na A na site na B, kpọọ isi ebe ha zutere C. N: Jiri arcs nwere otu radius, ogologo karịa AB, site na A na B dozie C.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.b: Radius dị ogologo karịa AB, ya mere AC na BC dịkwa ogologo karịa AB.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: N na-emepụta isosceles triangle ebe naanị AC=BC.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: Ọ dịghị nke na-emepụta equilateral triangle
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Na M, akụkụ atọ niile hà nhata AB.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Na M, AC na BC hà nhata na compass radius AB, ya mere akụkụ atọ niile hà nhata. N na-enye isosceles triangle nwere AC=BC>AB.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Na M, AC na BC hà nhata na radius AB, ya mere ọ bụ equilateral triangle nwere akụkụ atọ hà nhata.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: Na N, AC na BC dị ogologo karịa AB, ya mere akụkụ atọ ahụ hà nhataghị, ọ bụghịkwa equilateral triangle.

l-m-m1-b05-39.material: Mean e nwetara site na frequency distribution table hà nhata mean raw data? A: Ọ na-abụ otu kpọmkwem mgbe niile. B: Ọ na-ewere class ọ bụla dịka otu class mark, ya mere ọ bụ uru ntule ma nwee ike ịdị iche.

l-m-m1-b05-39.s.s1.explain: Na tebụl, a na-eji class mark dochie uru niile dị n'ime class maka ngụkọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịdịtụ iche na mean mbụ.
l-m-m1-b05-39.s.s2.model.0: A na-ewere uru niile n'ime class dịka class mark, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịdịtụ iche na mean mbụ.
l-m-m1-b05-39.s.s2.model.1: Uru raw data nwere ike ịdị iche na class mark, ya mere mean sitere na tebụl bụ uru ntule.

l-m-m1-b0s4-13.title: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ịchọta area sector
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta ịchọta area sector; họrọ nke dabara ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.material: Arc length sector radius 10 cm na central angle 72° bụ 4π cm. Ụzọ 1: 100π×72/360=20π. Ụzọ 2: ½×radius×arc length=½×10×4π=20π. Ha abụọ nyere otu uru.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta tụnyere ụzọ abụọ nke ọma bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.o.a: Naanị Ụzọ 1 ziri ezi, Ụzọ 2 bụ coincidence.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ mara arc length, Ụzọ 2 bụ formula na-arụ ọrụ mgbe niile.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.o.b: Ha abụọ ziri ezi; ma a maara arc length, Ụzọ 2 dị mfe.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.r.c: Ụzọ 1 kwa bụ ụzọ ziri ezi; ọ na-eji echiche sector bụ akụkụ circle.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.o.d: Uru ha bụ otu, ya mere central angle adịghị mkpa ịma.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.r.d: Ụzọ 2 kwa chọrọ central angle iji chọta arc length.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.explain: Ụzọ abụọ ziri ezi, otu uru. Ọ bụrụ naanị central angle mara, Ụzọ 1 dị mfe; ma arc length mara, Ụzọ 2 dị mfe.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s2.model.0: Ụzọ abụọ na-enye 20π ma ziri ezi; ma arc length mara, Ụzọ 2 nke bụ multiplication otu ugboro dị mfe.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s2.model.1: Ụzọ 1 ziri ezi n’ihi na sector bụ 72/360 nke circle; Ụzọ 2 na-emeso ya dịka triangle, ọ na-adị ngwa mgbe arc length dị.

l-m-m1-b01-38.topic: Iji nkewa kacha ukwuu jikọrọ ọnụ
l-m-m1-b01-38.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi ka e kesaa hà nhata, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta, họrọ nkwekọ dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b01-38.material: A na-ekesa swiiti 48 na jelii 36 n’enweghị ihe fọdụrụ. Otu ọ bụla ga-enweta opekata mpe 4 n’ụdị nke ọ bụla, ọnụ ọgụgụ otu ga-abụkwa nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ otu dabara n’ọnọdụ ahụ?

l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s1.r.c: Otu ọ bụla na-enweta jelii 3, ya mere ọnọdụ opekata mpe 4 emezughị.
l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị ike ikesa jelii 36 hà nhata n’otu 8.
l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s1.explain: Ndị nkewa jikọrọ ọnụ nke 48 na 36 bụ 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. Otu 12 anaghị arụ ọrụ n’ihi na nke ọ bụla na-enweta jelii 3; otu 6 kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s2.model.0: Otu 6 na-enye swiiti 8 na jelii 6 n’otu ọ bụla; ọnọdụ mezuru, ọnụ ọgụgụ otu kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b01-38.s.s2.model.1: Otu 12 na-emebi ọnọdụ opekata mpe 4 n’ihi na onye ọ bụla nwetara 3 jelii; nkewa jikọrọ ọnụ na-esote, 6, dabara.

l-m-m1-b01-40.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi oge ikiri vidiyo, tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta, họrọ nkwekọ dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b01-40.material: Ngwa nwere batrị 100% na-atụfu 12% kwa awa 1 mgbe a na-ekiri vidiyo. Ị chọrọ ikiri opekata mpe awa 2, hapụkwa batrị opekata mpe 20%. Ị chọrọ ikiri ogologo oge dịka o kwere.
l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s1.prompt: Oge ikiri kacha dabara n’ọnọdụ ndị a bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: Naanị 4% fọdụrụ, ya mere ọnọdụ opekata mpe 20% emezughị.
l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s1.r.c: Naanị 16% fọdụrụ, ya mere ọnọdụ opekata mpe 20% emezughị.
l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s1.r.d: Batrị 40% fọdụrụ, ya mere ị nwere ike ikiri ogologo karịa.
l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s1.explain: Mgbe awa 6 gachara, 72% apụọla, 28% fọdụrụ. Mgbe awa 7 gachara, naanị 16% fọdụrụ, nke na-adịghị arụ ọrụ.

l-m-m1-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Ka opekata mpe 20% fọdụrụ, mfu agaghị akarị 80%; awa 6, ebe 12×6=72, bụ nke kachasị.

l-m-m1-b02-37.material: Ị ga-erute ebe dị 10 km n’ime awa 1. Ije ije bụ 4 km/h ma n’efu, igwe bụ 15 km/h ma na-eri won 1500, bọs bụ 30 km/h ma na-eri won 2500, tagzi bụ 40 km/h ma na-eri won 8000. Ị chọrọ ego kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b02-37.s.s1.prompt: Olee ụzọ njem kacha dabara ọnọdụ ndị a?
l-m-m1-b02-37.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ oge, mana ọ na-efu ego kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b02-37.s.s1.r.c: 10÷4=2.5 awa, ya mere o mezughị ọnọdụ ime ya n’ime awa 1.
l-m-m1-b02-37.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ oge, mana ọ dị ọnụ karịa igwe.
l-m-m1-b02-37.s.s1.explain: Igwe na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 40 (10÷15), nke dị n’ime awa 1; ọ bụkwa nhọrọ kacha ọnụ ala nke mezuru ọnọdụ oge.

l-m-m1-b02-38.topic: Iji Polygon Nwere Akụkụ Hà nhata Jupụta Ala
l-m-m1-b02-38.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka taịlị polygon mgbe niile iji kpuchie ala, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b02-38.material: Ị chọrọ iji naanị otu ụdị taịlị polygon mgbe niile kpuchie ala, n’enweghị oghere ma ọ bụ ịdakwasị ibe ha. Akụkụ ndị na-ezukọ n’otu ebe ga-agbakọta 360°. Ị chọrọ ka ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ taịlị ahụ buru ibu dịka o kwere.

l-m-m1-b02-38.s.s1.r.a: Ọ pụrụ ikpuchi ala, mana e nwere taịlị nwere akụkụ karịa.
l-m-m1-b02-38.s.s1.r.b: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla bụ 108°, ya mere ha enweghị ike mejupụta 360° kpọmkwem.
l-m-m1-b02-38.s.s1.r.d: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla bụ 135°, ya mere ha enweghị ike mejupụta 360° kpọmkwem.
l-m-m1-b02-38.s.s1.explain: Hexagon mgbe niile nwere akụkụ 120°, ya mere atọ na-ezukọ na-eme 360°. N’etiti taịlị ndị nwere ike ikpuchi ala, ọ bụ ya kacha nwee akụkụ.
l-m-m1-b02-38.s.s2.model.0: Hexagon mgbe niile nwere akụkụ 120°, atọ na-ezukọ na-eme 360°, ya mere ọ nwere ike ikpuchi ala n’enweghị oghere.

l-m-m1-b03-36.material: Ụgwọ mbata otu bụ ụgwọ ntọala 12000 won tinyere 3000 won maka onye ọ bụla. Onye ọ bụla ga-akwụ 5000 won ma ọ bụ obere, ma ịchọrọ ịkpọkọta mmadụ ole na ole dịka o kwere.

l-m-m1-b03-37.material: A na-echekwa ihe oriri abụọ n’otu oghere. A chọrọ −5℃ ma ọ bụ elu, 2℃ ma ọ bụ ala; B chọrọ 0℃ ma ọ bụ elu, 6℃ ma ọ bụ ala. Họrọ okpomọkụ na-emeju ha abụọ.

l-m-m1-b03-37.s.s1.r.b: B mezuru, ma A chọrọ 2℃ ma ọ bụ ala nke a emezughị.

l-m-m1-b03-37.s.s1.explain: Họrọ n’etiti 0 na 2℃, ebe nso A bụ −5 ruo 2℃, nke B bụ 0 ruo 6℃ na-agbakọta. 1℃ dị n’ime ha.

l-m-m1-b03-38.material: Ị chọrọ ịga 6km n’ime awa 1. Ọsọ ije bụ 4km kwa awa, ọsọ ịgba bụ 8km kwa awa; anya abụọ ahụ ga-agbakọta 6km. Ị chọrọ ịgba obere ọsọ dịka o kwere n’ihi na ọ na-agwụ ike.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ewe ihe na-erughị awa 1, ma ị na-agba ọsọ kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ewe ihe na-erughị awa 1, ma anya ije nwere ike ịdị ogologo.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.d: Ịgbakwunye awa ije 3/4 na awa ịgba ọsọ 3/8 karịrị awa 1.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.explain: Ije 2km na ịgba ọsọ 4km na-ewe 0.5+0.5=1 awa. Ọ bụrụ anya ije ka ukwuu, ọ gafere awa 1.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s2.model.0: Maka 2km ije, 2÷4+4÷8=1 awa; ọnọdụ oge mezuru, anya ịgba ọsọ bụ nke kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s2.model.1: Ije 3km na-ewe awa 1.125, karịrị awa 1; ya mere 2km bụ oke anya ije.

l-m-m1-b03-39.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta n’ịhọrọ mmiri mkpụrụ osisi na mmiri, họrọ nkwekọ dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b03-39.material: Gwakọta mmiri mkpụrụ osisi na mmiri n’oke 1:3. Otu iko agaghị akarị 300mL; maka ụtọ, mmiri mkpụrụ osisi ga-adịkarịa ala 40mL. Ị chọrọ iji ntakịrị mmiri mkpụrụ osisi dịka o kwere.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.r.a: Mmiri mkpụrụ dị n’okpuru 40mL, ya mere ọnọdụ ụtọ emezughị.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma ị nwere ike iji mmiri mkpụrụ pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.explain: Maka mmiri mkpụrụ 40mL, mmiri bụ 120mL, ngụkọta 160mL. Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ma jiri mmiri mkpụrụ kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s2.model.0: Mmiri mkpụrụ 40mL na mmiri 120mL na-enye 160mL; ha mezuru ọnọdụ nha iko na ụtọ.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s2.model.1: Mmiri mkpụrụ ga-abụkarịa ala 40mL; obere ego mezuru ọnọdụ bụ 40mL.

l-m-m1-b03-40.title: Olu otu, akwụkwọ mkpuchi kacha nta
l-m-m1-b03-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta n’ịhọrọ ụdị ncha prism akụkụ anọ, họrọ nkwekọ kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b03-40.material: A ga-eji akwụkwọ kechie ncha prism akụkụ anọ nwere olu 24cm³. Ogologo, obosara, ịdị elu bụ nọmba zuru ezu cm; ịchọrọ iji akwụkwọ kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụdị na-eji akwụkwọ kacha nta?
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s1.r.a: Mpaghara elu bụ 68cm², e nwere nhọrọ pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s1.r.b: Mpaghara elu bụ 56cm², e nwere nhọrọ pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s1.r.d: Mpaghara elu bụ 70cm², e nwere nhọrọ pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara elu bụ 52cm² maka 2×3×4, 56cm² maka 2×2×6, 68cm² maka 1×4×6. 2×3×4 kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s2.model.0: 2×3×4 nwere mpaghara elu 52cm²; nhọrọ ndị ọzọ bụ 56, 68, 70cm², ya mere ọ chọrọ akwụkwọ kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b03-40.s.s2.model.1: Ka ogologo akụkụ atọ na-abịaru ibe ha nso, mpaghara elu na-adị nta; 2, 3, 4 dabara.

l-m-m1-b04-08.title: Ịhọrọ nha square tiles
l-m-m1-b04-08.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha mgbe ị na-ahọrọ nha square tiles; họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b04-08.material: A ga-ekpuchi floor ogologo 36 cm na obosara 48 cm kpamkpam site na square tiles otu nha, n’enweghị oghere. Ọnọdụ: side integer cm, tile 50 ma ọ bụ obere, tiles pere mpe dịka o kwere.
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s1.prompt: Side length mezuru ọnọdụ atọ nke ọma bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma tile pere mpe (6 cm) nwekwara ike.
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s1.r.b: 36÷8 anaghị ekewa nke ọma; oghere ga-adị.
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s1.explain: Side ga-abụ common divisor nke 36 na 48. 6 cm chọrọ tiles 48; 4 cm chọrọ 108; nke kacha nta nwere tiles 50 ma ọ bụ obere bụ 6 cm.
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s2.model.0: 6 cm na-ekewa 36 na 48, chọrọ 6×8=48 tiles, 50 ma ọ bụ obere. Ọ bụ nke kacha nta dabara.
l-m-m1-b04-08.s.s2.model.1: 12 cm chọrọ tiles 12, ma 6 cm pere mpe nwekwara ike; 6 cm dabara. 4 cm chọrọ 108, anaghị arụ.

l-m-m1-b04-16.goal: Mgbe a na-ekpebi ikewa rịbọn 60 cm, tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha; họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b04-16.material: Ị na-eji rịbọn 60 cm kee igbe abụọ. Ọ bụrụ x cm maka obere igbe, nnukwu igbe na-eji (2x+6) cm. A ga-eji opekata mpe 15 cm na obere igbe.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: x nke mezuru ọnọdụ atọ bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa 15 cm; ya mere ọ na-emebi obere igbe condition.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe nnukwu igbe ji 36 cm, total bụ 51 cm; 9 cm fọdụrụ.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe nnukwu igbe ji 46 cm, total bụ 66 cm, karịrị 60 cm.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Site na x+(2x+6)=60, 3x=54, x=18. 18 cm dịkarịa ala 15, total bụ 60.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x+(2x+6)=60, x=18, opekata mpe 15; ọnọdụ atọ niile mezuru.
l-m-m1-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: 12 cm erughị 15; 15 cm na-ahapụ 9 cm, 20 cm na-enye 66 cm. Ha adịghị arụ; ya mere 18 cm.

l-m-m1-b04-24.title: Ịchọta isi dabara na ihe ngosi atọ
l-m-m1-b04-24.goal: Mgbe a na-achọta ebe akụ zoro ezo dabara n'ihe ngosi atọ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b04-24.material: Ebe akụ zoro ezo (x, y) nwere x na y bụ integer. Ihe ngosi: ọ dị na quadrant nke 2, x+y=1, absolute value nke x erughị ma ọ bụ hà 3. N'ime ndị ga-ekwe omume, anyị chọrọ ịmalite igwu site n'isi nwere y kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu isi ka anyị kwesịrị igwu mbụ?
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ niile, ma ọ bụghị isi nwere y kacha nta.
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s1.r.b: x+y=1, ma ọ dị na quadrant nke 4.
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s1.r.d: x+y=1, ma absolute value nke x bụ 4, nke karịrị 3.
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s1.explain: Isi ndị na-emezu ihe ngosi atọ ahụ bụ (−1,2), (−2,3), na (−3,4), n'ime ha y kacha nta dị na (−1,2).
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s2.model.0: (−1,2) dị na quadrant nke 2, ngụkọta bụ 1, absolute value nke x bụ 1, ya mere ọ na-emezu ihe ngosi atọ. y ya bụkwa nke kacha nta, ya mere o dabara.
l-m-m1-b04-24.s.s2.model.1: N'ime isi ndị na-emezu ihe ngosi atọ ahụ, nke y kacha nta bụ (−1,2), ya mere o ziri ezi ịmalite igwu ebe a.

l-m-m1-b04-32.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekewa achicha gbara gburugburu kpamkpam ka ọ bụrụ akụkụ dịka sector nwere central angles hà nhata, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b04-32.material: Ị na-ekewa achicha gbara gburugburu kpamkpam ka ọ bụrụ akụkụ sector nwere central angles hà nhata. Central angle nke otu akụkụ ga-abụ integer degrees ma ọ dịkarịa ala 40°, ịchọrọkwa ọtụtụ akụkụ dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ akụkụ kacha emezu ọnọdụ atọ ahụ?
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.a: 360°÷7 abụghị integer degrees, ya mere ị pụghị ikewa ya hà nhata.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma ị nwere ike ikewa ya ruo akụkụ 9 (40°).
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.d: Central angle bụ 36°, ya mere ọ bụghị opekata mpe 40°.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.explain: Central angle bụ 360°÷ọnụọgụ akụkụ. Na akụkụ 9 ọ bụ 40°, nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, akụkụ 10 na-enye 36°, ya mere ọ naghị arụ ọrụ.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.0: Na pieces 9, central angle bụ 360÷9=40°, opekata mpe 40°; ọnọdụ mezuru ma pieces kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.1: Pieces 10 na-enye 36°, anaghị arụ; pieces 8 na-enye 45° ma pere mpe. Ya mere pieces 9 ziri ezi.

l-m-m1-b04-40.goal: Mgbe a na-ekpebi ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị mmadụ maka survey, tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha; họrọ nkwekọrịta dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b04-40.material: Questionnaire na-efu 150 won kwa sheet, budget kacha bụ 6,000 won. A ga-ahazi nsonaazụ ka relative frequencies, nke ọ bụla ga-abụ kpọmkwem n’ime decimal places abụọ. Jiri mmadụ ọtụtụ dịka o kwere.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.prompt: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ mezuru ọnọdụ atọ nke ọma bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.a: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma mmadụ 25 ka ga-ekwe omume.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.c: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma nyochaa mmadụ 25 nwere ike. Relative frequency nke 1 mmadụ bụ 0.025.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.explain: Ka relative frequencies bụrụ n’ime decimal places abụọ, ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ ga-abụ divisor nke 100. Nke kacha ukwuu na-erughị 40 sheets bụ 25.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.0: Mmadụ 25 na-efu 3,750 won, n’ime budget; otu onye bụ 1/25=0.04, n’ime decimal place 2. Mmadụ 40 ga-enye 0.025.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.1: N’ime divisors 100 ndị na-erughị 40, 25 bụ nke kacha ukwuu; nyochaa mmadụ 25.

l-m-m1-b05-32.title: Ịhọrọ akụkụ nke atọ nke ngere triangle
l-m-m1-b05-32.goal: Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ ogologo akụkụ nke atọ nke ngere triangle, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b05-32.material: Ị na-eme ngere ọdịdị triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ 7m na 4m. Akụkụ nke atọ ga-abụ integer m, ọ ga-emepụta triangle, perimeter niile agaghị agafe 18m, ọ ga-adịkwa ogologo dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu akụkụ nke atọ dabara n'ọnọdụ atọ ahụ kacha mma?
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: 7=4+3, ya mere akụkụ ndị ahụ ga-edokwa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, enweghịkwa triangle a ga-eme.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emepụta triangle, ma perimeter bụ 21m, nke karịrị 18m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: 7+4=11, ya mere akụkụ ndị ahụ ga-edokwa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, enweghị triangle a ga-eme.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.explain: N'ime triangle, akụkụ kacha ogologo ga-erughị ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na perimeter bụ 18m ma ọ bụ obere, akụkụ nke atọ bụ 7m ma ọ bụ obere, nke kacha ogologo n'ime ha bụ 7m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: Maka akụkụ atọ 7, 4, na 7, akụkụ kacha ogologo erughị ngụkọta abụọ ndị ọzọ, ya mere ha na-eme triangle, perimeter bụ 18m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: A naghị ekwe 10m n'ihi na perimeter ga-abụ 21m, 3m na 11m na-edokwa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere 7m dabara.

l-m-m1-b05-40.title: Ịhọrọ akara ule ise na-emezu ọnọdụ
l-m-m1-b05-40.goal: Maka akara ule ụmụ akwụkwọ ise na-emezu ọnọdụ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m1-b05-40.material: Kpebie akara ule ụmụ akwụkwọ ise. Mean bụ 80, median bụ 80, akara kacha elu bụ 95 ma ọ bụ obere, akara niile ga-adị iche. Mee ọdịiche n'etiti nke kacha elu na nke kacha ala ka o buru ibu dịka o kwere.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.prompt: N'ime nhọrọ, nke na-edobe ọnọdụ ma nwee ọdịiche kasị ukwuu?
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-edobe ọnọdụ, ma ọdịiche n'etiti nke kacha elu na nke kacha ala bụ 20, nke pere mpe.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.c: Ngụkọta bụ 405, ya mere mean abụghị 80, akara 100 karịrị 95.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.d: Akara 95 pụtara ugboro abụọ, ya mere akara ule niile adịghị iche.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.explain: Nhọrọ nke abụọ nwere mean na median 80, ọ bụ 95 ma ọ bụ obere, akara niile dị iche. Ọdịiche bụ 95−60=35, karịrị 20 nke nhọrọ mbụ.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s2.model.0: Ngụkọta bụ 400, ya mere mean bụ 80, etiti bụ 80, ha niile dị iche, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ọdịiche 35 bụkwa nke kasị ukwuu.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s2.model.1: Nke mbụ nwere ọdịiche pere mpe 20, nke atọ nwere ngụkọta 405, nke anọ nwere 95 ugboro abụọ, ya mere ha na-emebi ọnọdụ. Nke ahụ mere nke abụọ ji dabara.

l-m-m1-b0s4-14.material: Ị chọrọ ịdepụta points nwere x-coordinates −30, −15, 25, na 50. x-axis nwere squares 10 n’akụkụ nke ọ bụla nke origin. Họrọ nha square ka points niile daba na grid.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.prompt: Nha kacha dabara nke otu square bụ ole?
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.a: Iji depụta 50, square 25 dị mkpa, nke anaghị aba n’ime 10.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.c: −15 na 25 dị n’etiti grid lines; o siri ike ịdepụta kpọmkwem.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.d: −15 na 25 dị n’etiti grid lines; o siri ike ịdepụta kpọmkwem.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ otu square bụ 5, 50 dabara n’ime squares 10, −30 n’ime 6, −15 na 25 dakwara n’ahịrị grid. 2 na-agafe oke, 10 na 20 na-eme ka points ghara ịdaba n’ahịrị.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s2.model.0: Otu square 5 na-eme ka points niile daba n’ime squares 10 ma daa n’ahịrị grid; ọ kacha dabara.
